text:
sara: Quick heads-up — I'm seeing a small but reproducible token duplication when doing the keystone-prefill -> live KV handoff on the int4 quantized bring-up. Repro steps below, tried on two seeds.

ben: ugh. can you paste a tiny repro and logs? also which model/rope config?

sara: model: keystone-13b-int4 (v1.0.2-quant), rope: rotary_scale=1.0, prefill length=4096, live continuation ~128 tokens. Repro command:
```
./run_infer --model keystone-13b-int4 --prefill 4096 --continue 128 --kv-handoff && tail -n 50 run.log
```

sara: log excerpt shows duplicated token sequence around the handoff boundary:
```
INFO: kv_handoff: slot=4095 -> live_start=4096
DEBUG: emit: "the quick brown fox" (tokens 3987..4001)
DEBUG: emit: "the quick brown" (tokens 3987..3999)  <-- duplicate shorter span
```

liam: interesting. looks like a slot-skip/eviction heuristic might be re-emitting the tail. Did you test with rotary_scale=0.5 or 2.0?

sara: not yet. hypothesis: when ropeat scaling interacts with compressed kv indices, the alignment check occasionally picks a shorter overlap window and we get a partial re-emit. Could be an int4 rounding artifact in the index fingerprint.

maya: @sara can you run a quick matrix: {rotary_scale: [0.5,1.0,2.0], prefill: [2048,4096,8192], kv_eviction_thresh: [0.1,0.2,0.3]} and dump emitted tokens +/-16 around boundary? I can parallelize on a small farm.

sara: starting that now. also adding a control: same config but float32 (non-quant) to check a quant regression.

kv-test-bot: test queued: job=kv-hand-off-matrix-1881234567, shards=6. ETA ~22m. Results will post here as they finish. :robot_face:

ben: if float32 clean, then priority = quant-index-fingerprint bisect. If float32 also dup -> probably handoff logic.

liam: add a quick diff metric: ngram-dup-rate around handoff and a KL on softmax at token t-1 vs t after handoff. small script:
```
python tools/hand_off_diff.py --log run.log --window 16
```

sara: noted. I'll attach run artifacts when the bot posts. For triage: suspect interplay of (a) ropeat scaling math in pos-encode -> kv-index rounding and (b) eviction heuristic that recomputes overlap length. Int4 may amplify.

maya: also try forcing deterministic-kv-index (disable fingerprint) to see if fingerprints trigger nondet slot mapping.

sara: good call. adding that toggle.

kv-test-bot: job kv-hand-off-matrix-1881234567 shard-1 done. summary: rotary_scale=1.0 / prefill=4096 / kv_eviction_thresh=0.2 => dup-rate 0.83% (int4), float32 control => dup-rate 0.02%. More shards running.

ben: oof. clear quant regression. prioritize bisect of index-fingerprint commit range.

sara: opening a short RFC with repro and initial shard logs, cc @liam @ben. Will pin failing examples in the bug. Thanks all.

liam: ping me when RFC is up. I can try a micro-patch: tighten overlap clamp and add a sanity check that emitted tail isn't a strict subsequence of previous tokens.

maya: will watch results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
